  • What AI camera features does Samsung Galaxy A56 have?

    Galaxy A56 uses AI Awesome Intelligence for automatic scene optimisation, enhanced night photography, AI Zoom, portrait depth effects, best face, instant slo-mo and generative editing tools to improve every shot.

  • Does Samsung Galaxy A56 5G have a good display?

    Samsung Galaxy A56 5G features a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display with 120Hz refresh rate, delivering vivid colours, deep contrast, and smooth scrolling for streaming, gaming, and everyday use.

  • How long does Samsung Galaxy A56 5G battery last?

    Samsung Galaxy A56 5G has a 5,000 mAh battery designed to last up to 2 days. Calls, streaming, browsing, and social media are comfortably handled on a single charge.

  • How good is the Samsung Galaxy A56 5G camera?

    Galaxy A56 features a 50MP main camera with OIS, an ultra-wide lens, and a macro lens. AI processing improves results in all conditions, including low-light photography and video.

  • Is Samsung Galaxy A56 5G suitable for gaming?

    Galaxy A56 handles everyday gaming smoothly on its 120Hz display. The built-in 15 larger Vapor cooling chamber helps sustain stable performance during extended sessions.

    • A reviewer
      4 out of 5 stars
      It's a great deal considering the current phone market, otherwise there may have been better phones
      Reviewed in India on 8 September 2026
      Colour: Awesome Midnight BlueSize: 8GB RAM + 128GB StorageStyle Name: With exchange bonus or No cost EMI
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The phone does come with one ui 8.5 out of the box. Its been with me for about 2 weeks

      It did lose the 5g jio connection once and I rebooted it manually, it siad its optimizing apps and never faced that problem again.

      I've had this problem with other phones, when u click the internet icon, it takes like 1.5s to actually turn on 5g.

      I didn't put a screen protector yet. I did put a case the next day of it arriving. Not even a scratch on the screen. It also fell face first by toppling on the floor. No major damage(light scratch on the back). It's kinda durable.

      It looks crazy premium, got glass and metal build.

      It did heat a lot on the first day when I set it up. Later, it was mostly fine(note i dont game at all). If u have AC, u won't feel heating issues at all, If u don't have one, it can be warm with 5g. The battery is bad though. I'm a light to medium user yet it needs a small top of like 20% in the evening to survive all day.

      Camera - decent. It overproceses and makes everything look artificial especially night photos with ai, and u can't disable it. Otherwise, in good lighting, its natural.

      Important: it does lag here and there(even after its initial optimizing that it does for like a few days), but no major lags. It optimizes itself after a week. So don't judge it much in its first week alone. Don't buy if u r planning to game or are a heavy user. U won't find anything in this budget during the ram crisis anyway.

      It's still a great phone. But it if u want a phone that just works for like 4-5 years and u don't do anything heavy, buy it. there are not many good deals around this price during the shortage.

    About this Item

    • 𝐒𝐄𝐆𝐌𝐄𝐍𝐓 𝐌𝐎𝐒𝐓 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐏𝐋𝐄𝐓𝐄 𝐂𝐀𝐌𝐄𝐑𝐀 - Capture every detail with the 50MP Main camera. Big Pixel sensor and enhanced OIS (1.5°) for shake-free shots even in low light. Capture more in the frame with the 12MP Ultra-wide lens (123° FOV) or get close to the nature with the dedicated 5MP Macro lens. Get 4K recording, Video HDR on both front and rear cameras, AI-powered portraits and the improved AI Editing Tools like Object Eraser, Best Face and Auto Trim.
    • 𝐍𝐄𝐗𝐓-𝐆𝐄𝐍 𝐄𝐗𝐘𝐍𝐎𝐒 𝟏𝟓𝟖𝟎 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐂𝐄𝐒𝐒𝐎𝐑 - Built on a 4nm architecture, experience a massive leap in efficiency with 18% faster CPU, 17% improved GPU, and 12% enhanced NPU performance vs previous model. Whether gaming or multitasking, the flagship-grade 15% larger vapour cooling chamber keeps your device cool under pressure.
    • 𝐁𝐔𝐈𝐋𝐓 𝐓𝐎 𝐋𝐀𝐒𝐓 (𝐈𝐏𝟔𝟕, 𝐕𝐈𝐂𝐓𝐔𝐒+, 𝟓𝐗 𝐎𝐒 𝐔𝐏𝐆𝐑𝐀𝐃𝐄𝐒) - Features Gorilla Glass Victus+ on both the front and back for superior scratch and drop resistance. It also comes with a premium metal frame. With an IP67 rating, your phone is protected against dust and water splash. Experience the best of Samsung ecosystem with 5 generations of OS upgrades and 5 years of security updates, ensuring a high resale value and an updated user experience.

    • 𝐒𝐀𝐌𝐒𝐔𝐍𝐆 𝐄𝐗𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐈𝐄𝐍𝐂𝐄 - Get defense grade security with Samsung Knox, hassle free payments with Tap and Pay on Samsung Wallet, 5G connectivity and seamless experience with the latest One UI. What makes Galaxy A56 5G most trusted is being Made in India with 3300+ strong service network.
